examples.chinese: 我要紅茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào hóngchá.
examples.english: Black tea please.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 我喜歡聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I like to listen to music.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I like to listen to music.

examples.chinese: 我要在家看書、聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài jiā kànshū, tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I am going to read and listen to music at home.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕人喜歡聽流行音樂。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén xǐhuān tīng liúxíng yīnyuè.
examples.english: Many young people like to listen to popular music.

examples.chinese: 我常在網路上聽我喜歡的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng tīng wǒ xǐhuān de yīnyuè.
examples.english: I often listen to music I like on the internet.

examples.chinese: 公園的音樂晚會快要開始了，可不可以請你們幫我排那些椅子？
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán de yīnyuè wǎnhuì kuài yào kāishǐ le, kě bù kěyǐ qǐng nǐmen bāng wǒ pái nàxiē yǐzi?
examples.english: The park's music evening party is about to start; could you please help me line up those chairs?

examples.chinese: 大龍最近買了一套音響，每天回到家就聽他最愛的英國樂團的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Dàlóng zuìjìn mǎi le yī tào yīnxiǎng, měitiān huí dào jiā jiù tīng tā zuì ài de Yīngguó yuètuán de yīnyuè.
examples.english: Dalong recently bought a stereo set; every day when he gets home, he listens to music by his favorite British band.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 可是我只想聽音樂、睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng yīnyuè, shuìjiào.
examples.english: But I only want to listen to music and sleep.

items.wordHook: 音(sound) + 樂(happy) → sound that makes you happy is music.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼你不吃冰淇淋？ B:因為天氣有點兒冷，所以我想吃一點兒熱的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ bù chī bīngqílín? B: Yīnwèi tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yīdiǎnr rè de.
examples.english: A: Why don't you eat ice cream? B: Because the weather is a little cold, so I want to eat something a little hot.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼你不吃冰淇淋？ B:因為天氣有點兒冷，所以我想吃一點兒熱的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme nǐ bù chī bīngqílín? B: Yīnwèi tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, suǒyǐ wǒ xiǎng chī yīdiǎnr rè de.
examples.english: A: Why don't you eat ice cream? B: Because the weather is a little cold, so I want to eat something a little hot.

examples.chinese: 老師為什麼還沒來？大家都覺得很奇怪。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī wèishénme hái méi lái? Dàjiā dōu juéde hěn qíguài.
examples.english: Why hasn't the teacher come yet? Everyone feels it's very strange.

examples.chinese: 你很餓嗎？為什麼吃得這麼快？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn è ma? Wèishénme chī de zhème kuài?
examples.english: Are you very hungry? Why are you eating so fast?

examples.chinese: 為什麼她咖啡喝了一半就不喝了？
examples.pinyin: Wèishénme tā kāfēi hē le yíbàn jiù bù hē le?
examples.english: Why did she drink half of her coffee and then stop drinking?

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.
examples.english: Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact.

examples.chinese: 孩子：我玩電腦遊戲玩得正高興，你為什麼不讓我繼續玩？爸爸：得了！你玩到眼睛都紅了。去外面運動運動。
examples.pinyin: Háizi: Wǒ wán diànnǎo yóuxì wán de zhèng gāoxìng, nǐ wèishénme bù ràng wǒ jìxù wán? Bàba: Dé le! Nǐ wán dào yǎnjing dōu hóng le. Qù wàimiàn yùndòng yùndòng.
examples.english: Child: I'm having a great time playing computer games, why won't you let me keep playing? Dad: That's enough! You've played until your eyes are all red. Go outside and get some exercise.

examples.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
examples.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyou.
examples.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 週末到花蓮的火車票一下子就賣光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò dào Huālián de huǒchēpiào yīxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.
examples.english: Weekend train tickets to Hualien sold out in an instant.

examples.chinese: 這班車早上七點從台北出發，只停了三個站就到花蓮了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān chē zǎoshang qī diǎn cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhǐ tíng le sān ge zhàn jiù dào Huālián le.
examples.english: This train departs from Taipei at 7 a.m.; it stops at only three stations and then arrives in Hualien.

examples.chinese: 花蓮的風景很美，我想多留兩天，慢慢地看。
examples.pinyin: Huālián de fēngjǐng hěn měi, wǒ xiǎng duō liú liǎng tiān, mànmàn de kàn.
examples.english: Hualien's scenery is beautiful; I want to stay two more days and look around slowly.

examples.chinese: 花蓮那幾家旅館的雙人客房都客滿了，我們還是訂民宿吧。
examples.pinyin: Huālián nà jǐ jiā lǚguǎn de shuāngrén kèfáng dōu kèmǎn le, wǒmen háishì dìng mínsù ba.
examples.english: The double guest rooms at those hotels in Hualien are all fully booked; we'd better book a homestay instead.

examples.chinese: 花蓮太魯閣的確很漂亮，難怪每年都吸引許多觀光客去參觀。
examples.pinyin: Huālián Tàilǔgé dequè hěn piàoliang, nánguài měinián dōu xīyǐn xǔduō guānguāngkè qù cānguān.
examples.english: Hualien's Taroko Gorge is indeed very beautiful; no wonder it attracts many tourists to visit every year.

examples.chinese: 史小姐到花蓮來觀光時不小心迷了路，幸虧遇到了熱心的阿姨送她回旅館。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě dào Huālián lái guānguāng shí bù xiǎoxīn mí le lù, xìngkuī yùdào le rèxīn de āyí sòng tā huí lǚguǎn.
examples.english: When Miss Shi came to Hualien for sightseeing, she accidentally got lost; fortunately, she met a warmhearted auntie who took her back to the hotel.

examples.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

examples.chinese: 不少人喜歡買像史努比那樣可愛的娃娃。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén xǐhuān mǎi xiàng Shǐnǔbǐ nàyàng kě'ài de wáwa.
examples.english: Many people like to buy cute dolls like Snoopy.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
examples.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

examples.chinese: 像慢跑、游泳那樣的運動，對健康極有幫助。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng mànpǎo, yóuyǒng nàyàng de yùndòng, duì jiànkāng jí yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: Sports like jogging and swimming are extremely helpful for health.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 假如東西買回家後常擺著不用，那樣的消費就是不必要的。在開心消費前應先想想，那些商品是不是需要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú dōngxī mǎi huí jiā hòu cháng bǎi zhe bù yòng, nàyàng de xiāofèi jiù shì bù bìyào de. Zài kāixīn xiāofèi qián yīng xiān xiǎngxiang, nàxiē shāngpǐn shì bu shì xūyào de.
examples.english: If things are often left unused after being bought and brought home, that kind of consumption is unnecessary. Before happily consuming, you should first think about whether those products are needed.

examples.chinese: 鄉村生活雖然不如都市那樣方便，但風景美多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiāngcūn shēnghuó suīrán bùrú dūshì nàyàng fāngbiàn, dàn fēngjǐng měi duō le.
examples.english: Although countryside life is not as convenient as the city, the scenery is much more beautiful.

examples.chinese: 像足球、籃球那樣激烈的運動，常讓運動員的小腿、手、腳受傷。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zúqiú, lánqiú nàyàng jīliè de yùndòng, cháng ràng yùndòngyuán de xiǎotuǐ, shǒu, jiǎo shòushāng.
examples.english: Intense sports like soccer and basketball often cause athletes to injure their lower legs, hands, and feet.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.chinese: 很多外國學生弄不清楚漢字的聲調。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguó xuéshēng nòng bù qīngchǔ Hànzì de shēngdiào.
examples.english: Many foreign students cannot get the tones of Chinese characters clear.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái hěn kěpà.
examples.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

examples.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
examples.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

examples.chinese: 你聽，這是什聲音？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, zhè shì shénme shēngyīn?
examples.english: Listen, what sound is this?

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.
examples.english: Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
examples.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

examples.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Dāng zhōuwéi huánjìng hěn jìng de shíhou, kěyǐ tīngjiàn píngcháng tīng bù dào de shēngyīn.
examples.english: When the surrounding environment is very quiet, you can hear sounds that you normally cannot hear.

examples.chinese: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì bǐsài dào le jǐnzhāng de shíhòu, guānzhòng jiù dàshēng jiàohǎn, wǒ yě gēnzhe hǎn.
examples.english: Every time the game reaches a tense moment, the audience shouts loudly, and I shout along too.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 每天早上都有人在附近公園大聲唱流行歌，聽久了真的很煩。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang dōu yǒu rén zài fùjìn gōngyuán dàshēng chàng liúxínggē, tīng jiǔ le zhēn de hěn fán.
examples.english: Every morning someone sings pop songs loudly in the nearby park; after hearing it for a long time, it's really annoying.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
examples.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

examples.chinese: 我最近皮膚又紅又癢，暫時不能吃太辣或太鹹的食物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn pífū yòu hóng yòu yǎng, zànshí bùnéng chī tài là huò tài xián de shíwù.
examples.english: Recently my skin has been red and itchy, so for the time being I can't eat food that is too spicy or too salty.

examples.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
examples.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 要是新買的商品有問題，七天以內可帶收據到店裡處理。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi xīn mǎi de shāngpǐn yǒu wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi kě dài shōujù dào diànlǐ chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If there's a problem with a newly purchased product, within seven days you can bring the receipt to the store to handle it.

examples.chinese: 他手上有傷，醫師建議他三日以內不要碰水，以免感染。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng yǒu shāng, yīshī jiànyì tā sān rì yǐnèi bùyào pèng shuǐ, yǐmiǎn gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: He has an injury on his hand, and the doctor advised him not to touch water for three days to avoid infection.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

examples.chinese: 學習不應該只在校園裡，也包括課外學習。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí bù yīnggāi zhǐ zài xiàoyuán lǐ, yě bāokuò kèwài xuéxí.
examples.english: Learning should not be limited to the campus; it also includes extracurricular learning.

examples.chinese: 別怕失敗，因為失敗的經驗比成功更珍貴。
examples.pinyin: Bié pà shībài, yīnwèi shībài de jīngyàn bǐ chénggōng gèng zhēnguì.
examples.english: Don't be afraid of failure, because the experience of failure is more precious than success.

items.wordHook: 作(make) + 業(work) → the work you make yourself do: homework.
客(guest) + 廳(hall) → the hall where you host guests, so 客廳 is the living room.
Two lovers bound by tender 情(feeling) traveling as a devoted 侶(companion) pair: 情侶 means couple.
Lifting water from the flowing 氺(water) with two steady hands, one vows to shoulder the task and 承(undertake).
Combining 早(early) and 晚(night): 早晚 means morning and evening.
時(time) + 間(space): time is the space in which things happen.
a 穴(cave) hides a 牙(tooth) biting through cloth → 穿(wear).
The 辶(movement) carries the 辟(law) away, so you 避(avoid).
